shared_elements: rows of repeated short strokes attached to or near a longer line
justification: The most specific shared content is the use of schematic linear motifs, especially repeated short strokes associated with longer curved or horizontal lines. The biggest difference is that A depicts long boat-like forms with rows of occupants or oars, while B depicts a single frontal anthropomorphic figure with facial and body features, so the iconographic subjects and overall scheme are quite different.
